pipeline::base00.widen_rounds.reason: The pre-Phase-A coverage auditor incremented its round counter before checking whether any relaxation lever could actually be applied, so it counted one no-op iteration. base00 has only two applicable levers (price_band, geography) and its golden 'relaxations' list correctly holds two entries, which is what shows the counter was wrong rather than the behaviour. Every reported statistic -- psf series, counts, rankings, total, yoy, span, coverage, rejected -- is byte-identical before and after. Consequence for the report: the claim that cycle 1 'fired 3 rounds in all 1080 runs' was partly this over-count; the substantive statement is that cycle 1 exhausted its available levers in every run, which is what explains the zero control-path divergence.
